Hey, our Platform Engineering team just wrapped up Sprint 42 and we need to get everything logged before EOD Friday. I've left a brief at `/workspace/sprint_retrospective_brief.txt` that summarizes everything that happened this sprint — completed work, things that are blocked, and stuff still in progress across two projects.

Please go through the brief and log every item into our centralized dev tracking system. Make sure each entry is properly categorized by project, has the right status, and is tagged with the relevant technologies mentioned.

Once everything is logged, pull together a summary and save it as `sprint42_summary.json` somewhere in the workspace. The summary should reflect both projects and give a sense of overall sprint health (totals, statuses, etc.).

Thanks.
